title: Filesystem backend: FsStore and FsBlockStore implementation
description: Implement FsStore: IpfsStore (transit) and FsBlockStore: IpfsBlockStore (reader) using tokio::fs. put: compute CID, write to <path>/<CID>.tmp then rename (atomic). skip if file already exists. get: read <path>/<CID>, map ENOENT to None. delete: unlink, return Immediate. Soft cap enforcement if max_bytes configured. Blocked on: stoa-cc6d42a7.
